marina-bay-sands.name: Marina Bay Sands
marina-bay-sands.price_text: SkyPark observation deck ≈ SGD 32 (check current price online)
marina-bay-sands.hours: Deck usually 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
marina-bay-sands.tip: Book the SkyPark deck online for a fixed slot and go near sunset for day and night views.

gardens-bay.name: Gardens by the Bay
gardens-bay.price_text: Outdoor gardens free · conservatories ≈ SGD 32 combined (check on the day)
gardens-bay.tip: See the free Supertree light show in the evening, then pay for the cooled conservatories earlier in the day.
gardens-bay.best: Late afternoon plus evening light show

merlion-park.name: Merlion Park
merlion-park.tip: Come early morning for fewer crowds and a clear view across the bay to Marina Bay Sands.

jewel-changi.name: Jewel Changi Airport
jewel-changi.price_text: Mall and Rain Vortex free · attractions ticketed
jewel-changi.tip: The Rain Vortex is free to see. Allow extra time if you are heading to a flight.
jewel-changi.best: Any time; good on a rainy day

chinatown-heritage.name: Chinatown Heritage District
chinatown-heritage.price_text: Free to walk · temples and museums ticketed separately
chinatown-heritage.tip: Walk the side lanes off Pagoda Street for shophouses and food stalls away from the main crowd.

buddha-tooth.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
buddha-tooth.tip: Dress modestly: cover shoulders and knees. The rooftop garden is quiet and often missed.

kampong-glam.name: Kampong Glam & Haji Lane
kampong-glam.tip: See the Sultan Mosque, then browse Haji Lane's small shops and cafés in the afternoon.

little-india.name: Little India
little-india.tip: Go hungry: the Tekka area and nearby lanes have cheap, excellent Indian food.

raffles-hotel.name: Raffles Hotel
raffles-hotel.price_text: Lobby free · afternoon tea and drinks priced separately
raffles-hotel.hours: Public areas about 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
raffles-hotel.tip: Walk the colonial courtyard for free. Book the Long Bar or afternoon tea ahead if you want them.

universal-studios.name: Universal Studios Singapore
universal-studios.price_text: One-day ticket ≈ SGD 83–90 (check on the day)
universal-studios.hours: Usually 10:00–19:00 · hours vary, check on the day
universal-studios.tip: Buy tickets online and arrive at opening. Weekdays are much quieter than weekends.

marina-bay.name: Marina Bay
marina-bay.tip: Walk the full loop at dusk: Merlion Park, Helix Bridge and the Esplanade all connect.

bird-paradise.name: Bird Paradise
bird-paradise.tip: It is far from the centre in Mandai. Plan a half day and check the shuttle or bus route first.

breadtalk.name: BreadTalk
breadtalk.tip: A cheap, quick breakfast: grab a pork floss bun and a coffee at any mall outlet.

chilli-crab.name: Chilli Crab
chilli-crab.price_text: ≈ SGD 60–120 per crab depending on size and restaurant
chilli-crab.tip: Order fried mantou buns to soak up the sauce. Ask the price per kilo before you order.

chinatown-market.name: Chinatown Street Market
chinatown-market.price_text: Free to browse · food from about SGD 3–8
chinatown-market.tip: Haggle gently on souvenirs and eat at the nearby hawker centre for better value.

clarke-quay.name: Clarke Quay
clarke-quay.price_text: Free to walk · drinks and boat rides extra
clarke-quay.tip: Walk the river here at night for the lights. Riverside drinks are pricey; happy hour helps.

esplanade.name: Esplanade - Theatres on the Bay
esplanade.tip: Check the free outdoor waterfront concerts, often in the evening.

fort-siloso.name: Fort Siloso
fort-siloso.tip: On Sentosa, so combine it with the beach. It is a short walk or shuttle from the main resort area.

haw-par-villa.name: Haw Par Villa
haw-par-villa.tip: Odd and memorable: the Ten Courts of Hell dioramas are not for young children.

helix-bridge.name: Helix Bridge
helix-bridge.tip: Walk it at night for the best skyline photos of Marina Bay Sands.

kidzania.name: KidZania Singapore
kidzania.price_text: Child ≈ SGD 40 · adults cheaper (check on the day)
kidzania.tip: Best for children roughly 4–12. Book online and go on a weekday if you can.

lau-pa-sat.name: Lau Pa Sat
lau-pa-sat.hours: About 24 hours · satay street in the evening
lau-pa-sat.tip: Come after 19:00 when the outdoor satay street opens. Bring cash for some stalls.

hawker-dinner.name: Hawker centre dinner
hawker-dinner.hours: Most stalls about 10:00–21:00 · some close early
hawker-dinner.tip: Bring small notes and tissues. Return your tray when you finish.

river-cruise.name: Singapore River cruise
river-cruise.price_text: ≈ SGD 25–30 for about 40 minutes (check on the day)
river-cruise.hours: Boats usually from about 09:00 to late evening
river-cruise.tip: Take it after dark from Clarke Quay to Marina Bay for the lit-up skyline.

southern-ridges.name: Southern Ridges walk
southern-ridges.tip: Start early to avoid heat. The Henderson Waves bridge is the highlight.

tiong-bahru.name: Tiong Bahru neighbourhood walk
tiong-bahru.price_text: Free to walk · food and coffee extra
tiong-bahru.tip: Old art-deco flats, a good market and small cafés. Go in the morning before the heat.

supertree-show.name: Supertree Grove light show
supertree-show.hours: Usually two shows each evening · check times on the day
supertree-show.tip: Lie on the ground under the trees for the best view. Arrive a little early.

orchard-road.name: Orchard Road shopping walk
orchard-road.tip: Air-conditioned malls connect underground. Good on a hot or rainy afternoon.
